# Copilot Working Style

Prioritise implementation over extended analysis.

- For straightforward coding tasks, inspect the relevant files and make the change immediately.
- Keep planning brief. Do not spend excessive time explaining the plan before coding.
- Prefer implementing a reasonable solution and testing it over analysing many hypothetical approaches.
- Do not repeatedly reconsider an approach unless new evidence shows it is wrong.
- For debugging, investigate the most likely cause first.
- Run the smallest relevant test before broadening the investigation.
- Avoid scanning the entire repository unless necessary.
- Do not refactor unrelated code.
- Make minimal, targeted changes.
- Preserve existing architecture and conventions unless specifically asked to change them.
- If the task is clear, proceed without asking unnecessary questions.

## Response style

- Be concise.
- Do not provide lengthy explanations before making changes.
- Summarise what changed after implementation.
- Report test results clearly.
- Mention unresolved problems only when they materially affect the task.
